Heartfelt Tributes Emerge as Inspirational Brazilian Girl with Rare Disorder, Elis Lima Carneiro, Passes Away at Five

October 8, 2026 by Daren Toone
Listen to audio version of this article
Sponsored by
0:00 / 3:08
Instaread

Boa Vista, Brazil — A Brazilian family is mourning the loss of five-year-old Elis Lima Carneiro, who passed away on September 30 after battling Hutchinson-Gilford Progeria Syndrome (HGPS), a rare condition characterized by accelerated aging. The heartbreaking announcement was made by her older brother, Guilherme Lago, through a poignant message shared on their popular Instagram account, which has garnered more than 1.5 million followers.

Elis was born on May 4, 2021, and throughout her short life, she became a symbol of resilience and joy despite her severe medical challenges. Reports indicate that she succumbed to a severe lung infection, emphasizing the difficulties faced by those with this uncommon genetic disorder. Progeria dramatically shortens a person’s lifespan; individuals usually do not live beyond their mid-teens.

In wake of her passing, the family organized a wake at the Shalon funeral home in Boa Vista, inviting friends, family, and supporters to share in their grief. An Instagram post conveyed their appreciation to those who wished to pay tribute to Elis, stating, “Everyone who wishes to say goodbye to Elis and accompany us on this last path will be very welcome.” The family’s intention was to create a space for community support while celebrating the love surrounding their daughter.

On October 1, a funeral procession commenced from the chapel, making its way to the Parque Campo da Saudade Cemetery. The turnout was a testament to the community’s deep connection with the family and the impact Elis had made during her brief life. Following the burial, the family shared a moving message online, celebrating the outpouring of love they experienced during their time of loss. “Love was present in every hug, every tear and every person who was there to say goodbye to our Elis,” they wrote.

Elis was not the only twin diagnosed with HGPS; her sister, Eloá, also has the condition, making them unique in the world as the only known twins with Progeria. Their parents have passionately advocated for the rights and awareness of individuals with rare syndromes. Reports confirm that Elis frequently participated in public discussions to promote understanding of these conditions.

Tributes poured in following the announcement of Elis’s passing, with her Instagram post receiving nearly a million likes and tens of thousands of heartfelt comments. Notable figures, including Brazilian entertainers such as Ana Castela, publicly expressed their condolences, highlighting the widespread impact Elis had beyond her personal circle.

Elis’s Instagram account chronicled her daily life, showcasing joyful moments spent with toys, family, and during medical appointments, offering a glimpse into the life of a child handling extraordinary circumstances with a spirit that resonated with many. Her mother, Eleismar Carneiro, noted that Elis consistently displayed bravery and humor, often laughing at simple pleasures despite her condition.

As news of her death circulated online, many users reflected on the courage Elis exhibited throughout her battle with illness. The account remains a heartfelt chronicle, capturing the essence of childhood amid the trials of a serious health condition. It serves as both a reminder of the fragility of life and the importance of connection and community in times of anguish.
